body:
CLAUDE LANE GATE LAUNCH (interim, Fable2 2026-10-17 22:20Z): on the running host build 459f8540, a Claude root session's Bash-BACKGROUND gate launch fences its own credit. It counts as outstanding background work (ClaudeHazardCause::OwnSession, src/claude_outstanding_work.rs). Bug: w-b576a44fb793 (P1).
Until it is fixed, Claude lanes (Opus3 and other Claude lanes: BarA1, BarA2, CSharpProof) launch full gates DETACHED, as one FOREGROUND Bash call:
  pushd "ROOT" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-8112
in a turn that begins focused on the item, then end the turn. Fable2 gets the notify and wakes the lane.
Codex lanes keep their usual form.

ADDED 2026-10-18 01:29Z (Fable2's own lesson). ANY Claude Bash run_in_background or Monitor task restricts evidence, even a read-only watcher that only polls the API: the host cannot see that it is read-only. It restricts this session, and other sessions lose credit for tests in workspaces under its workdir. Fable2's workdir is the main checkout, which contains every .tmp/wt-* lane worktree. Fable2 therefore never uses background shells or Monitor; it checks gate stages by hand on wakes. (Occurrence: task bdr92a8ag, 01:26–01:27:30Z, overlapping the w-affe gate test-e2706734; disclosed on w-affe8a4dee48.)
